WITH order_days AS (
  -- one row per order, with its day on Amsterdam's clock
  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN channel = 'web'
              THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE)
              ELSE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) END AS order_day
  FROM orders
),
lines AS (
  -- one row per line of an order placed in 2024, as stored, numbered within each set of copies
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', d.order_day) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
                            ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) AS copy_no
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_days AS d ON d.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE d.order_day >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND d.order_day < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
as_stored AS (
  -- one row per month: the depth from every line as stored
  SELECT month_start,
         100.0 * SUM(line_discount_eur) / SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur) AS depth_stored
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY month_start
),
cleaned AS (
  -- one row per month: each set of copies once, prices in cents turned into euros
  SELECT month_start,
         SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur THEN unit_price_eur * 0.01 ELSE unit_price_eur END) AS gross_eur,
         SUM(line_discount_eur) AS discount_eur
  FROM lines
  WHERE copy_no = 1
  GROUP BY month_start
)
-- one row per month of 2024
SELECT c.month_start,
       c.gross_eur,
       c.discount_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * c.discount_eur / c.gross_eur, 2) AS depth_pct,
       ROUND(s.depth_stored, 2) AS depth_as_stored_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * c.discount_eur / c.gross_eur
             - LAG(100.0 * c.discount_eur / c.gross_eur) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start), 2) AS change_pts
FROM cleaned AS c
JOIN as_stored AS s ON s.month_start = c.month_start
ORDER BY c.month_start

WITH order_days AS (
  -- one row per order, with its day on Amsterdam's clock
  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN CAST(order_ts AS DATE)
              ELSE CAST((order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) END AS order_day
  FROM orders
),
line_sets AS (
  -- one row per set of copies of a line of an order placed in 2024, with the number of copies
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', d.order_day) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur,
         COUNT(*) AS n_copies
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_days AS d ON d.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE d.order_day BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.order_day, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur
),
monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024, cleaned and as stored
  SELECT month_start,
         SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur THEN unit_price_eur / 100 ELSE unit_price_eur END) AS gross_eur,
         SUM(line_discount_eur) AS discount_eur,
         SUM(n_copies * line_discount_eur) AS discount_stored_eur,
         SUM(n_copies * quantity * unit_price_eur) AS gross_stored_eur
  FROM line_sets
  GROUP BY month_start
),
depths AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024, with its two depths
  SELECT month_start, gross_eur, discount_eur,
         100.0 * discount_eur / gross_eur AS depth,
         100.0 * discount_stored_eur / gross_stored_eur AS depth_stored
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month_start, gross_eur, discount_eur,
       ROUND(depth, 2) AS depth_pct,
       ROUND(depth_stored, 2) AS depth_as_stored_pct,
       ROUND(depth - LAG(depth) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 2) AS change_pts
FROM depths
ORDER BY month_start

WITH order_months AS (
  -- one row per order placed in 2024, with its month on Amsterdam's clock
  SELECT order_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', order_day) AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM (
    -- one row per order, with its day on Amsterdam's clock
    SELECT order_id,
           CASE WHEN channel = 'web'
                THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE)
                ELSE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) END AS order_day
    FROM orders
  ) AS o
  WHERE order_day >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND order_day <= DATE '2024-12-31'
),
stored AS (
  -- one row per month: the depth from every line as stored
  SELECT m.month_start, 100.0 * SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur) AS depth_stored
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_months AS m ON m.order_id = ol.order_id
  GROUP BY m.month_start
),
distinct_lines AS (
  -- one row per line of a 2024 order, each set of copies once
  SELECT DISTINCT m.month_start, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_months AS m ON m.order_id = ol.order_id
),
cleaned AS (
  -- one row per month: copies once, prices in cents turned into euros
  SELECT l.month_start,
         SUM(l.quantity * CASE WHEN l.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur THEN l.unit_price_eur / 100 ELSE l.unit_price_eur END) AS gross_eur,
         SUM(l.line_discount_eur) AS discount_eur
  FROM distinct_lines AS l
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  GROUP BY l.month_start
),
with_depth AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024, with its cleaned depth unrounded
  SELECT c.month_start, c.gross_eur, c.discount_eur, 100.0 * c.discount_eur / c.gross_eur AS depth, s.depth_stored
  FROM cleaned AS c
  JOIN stored AS s ON s.month_start = c.month_start
)
SELECT month_start, gross_eur, discount_eur,
       ROUND(depth, 2) AS depth_pct,
       ROUND(depth_stored, 2) AS depth_as_stored_pct,
       ROUND(depth - LAG(depth, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 2) AS change_pts
FROM with_depth
ORDER BY month_start

solver.query:
WITH ol AS (
 SELECT l.*, o.channel, CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.order_id, l.product_id, l.quantity, l.unit_price_eur, l.promo_id, l.line_discount_eur ORDER BY l.order_line_id) AS rn,
  (l.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur) AS cents
 FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
), d AS (
 SELECT *, CAST(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN (ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' ELSE ts END AS DATE) AS od,
  quantity * CASE WHEN cents THEN unit_price_eur / 100.0 ELSE unit_price_eur END AS gross,
  quantity * unit_price_eur AS gross_stored
 FROM ol
), y AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE od >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND od <= DATE '2024-12-31'),
m AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month', od)::DATE AS month_start,
  SUM(gross) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS gross_eur,
  SUM(line_discount_eur) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS discount_eur,
  100.0 * SUM(line_discount_eur) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) / SUM(gross) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS depth,
  100.0 * SUM(line_discount_eur) / SUM(gross_stored) AS depth_stored
 FROM y GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month_start, gross_eur, discount_eur,
 ROUND(depth, 2) AS depth_pct,
 ROUND(depth_stored, 2) AS depth_as_stored_pct,
 ROUND(depth - LAG(depth) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 2) AS change_pts
FROM m ORDER BY month_start
